fact: The World Bank's assessment of Rwanda's basic education system (3,831 primary schools of 4,842 schools), dated 27 May 2024, says each student has a profile in SDMS, that SDMS has no component for daily attendance and teachers record only aggregated attendance once a month, that national exams for P6, S3 and S6 are captured in SDMS, and that CA-MIS is used by teachers mainly to record the three annual end-of-term exam grades.
title: Learning Resilience in Rwanda Basic Education System
